history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, tousled hair is seated on a dark wicker sofa, looking to his right. He's wearing a black t-shirt with a silver cross necklace, and a light grey sweater is draped over his shoulders. His left arm rests on his lap, while his right arm is on the armrest of the sofa. He's wearing a silver wristwatch. His pants are a loose, light grey material. The background features large windows with a view of an outdoor area at night, with blurred lights from buildings and trees visible. The lighting is dim, with soft, ambient light illuminating the man and the immediate seating area, creating a slightly moody and relaxed atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by dark tones, grays, and muted blues from the background lights. The overall style is candid and contemporary.
